decisions.reason: A cheap complementary accessory that ties up almost no resources, so even with no website visibility in 2020–2021 there is no shortfall that would trigger search, and slack easily carries it.
A core box trailer line that likely benefited from strong private demand for trailers during the pandemic and plausibly meets aspirations, though its absence from the website adds some uncertainty.

A niche car transporter line whose results remain uncertain after several years and which was not visible in 2020–2021, making it the most likely candidate for pruning, but current slack still allows retention.
A low-bed series close to core competencies with steady professional and private demand, showing no clear sign of falling short of aspiration.
A high-cover series that broadens the core range and fits the firm's growth strategy, so management keeps it despite limited recent visibility.
